uv254 / bill of materials

Bill of materials

Parts for one set of uv254 boards (UV-Detector v0.5, UV-Emitter v0.5, UV-Control v0.4) and the two cables between them. From the KiCad schematics on 2026-11-23. UV-Control v0.4 is released; the detector and emitter v0.5 are still in progress, so check those against their schematics before ordering.

Order list UV-Detector v0.5 UV-Emitter v0.5 UV-Control v0.4 Cables Not in the design yet

Order list

Everything for one set, by manufacturer part number: 52 lines. The Buy links search Digi-Key for each part number; the CSV loads into Digi-Key's or Mouser's BOM upload. The part numbers are suggestions: any equivalent passive works (same value and package, same or higher voltage, same dielectric). The Feather and the 5644 boost breakout link to Adafruit, and the display to Amazon.

JP1 (solder jumper) and H1-H4 (mounting holes) have no part. J3 takes one shunt (Sullins SPC02SYAN); use J3 or JP1, never both. The Feather (U2) plugs into two 8.5 mm female sockets (16 and 12 pin). Fit either the on-board boost (U6 with L1, D3, C1-C3, R3, R10, R16) or Adafruit's 5644 breakout at J8, not both. The display can be soldered straight to the board or plugged into a 0.1 in socket.

Cables

Two cables, wired pin 1 to pin 1 (ready-made JST PH cables are often reversed, pin 1 to pin 6, and those don't work here):

CableEndsParts
Control J1 to detector J27-pin JST PH2 JST PHR-7 housings, 7 leads
Control J2 to emitter J26-pin JST PH2 JST PHR-6 housings, 6 leads

The leads are JST ASPHSPH24K152 (6 in, crimped at both ends, pushed into the housings), 13 in all. Or crimp JST SPH-002T-P0.5S terminals onto 24-28 AWG wire. All four links go to Digi-Key.

Not in the design yet

The control board has no source for V_LED (the emitter's +12V, J2 pin 4) until the boost for the UV LED is added, so its parts aren't listed. Until then, feed V_LED from a bench supply on J5 pin 4. (J5 pin 3, 5V, isn't connected to anything else.)

Made by scripts/make-bom.py from the schematics in the uv254 repository; also as BOM.md and bom.csv. Hardware CERN-OHL-S-2.0.
